description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git submodules, worktrees, and related operations within a project. It sets up repositories, creates worktrees, and performs various Git commands to test functionality involving submodules and worktrees.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in a specified repository with given files.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed with a description.

methods.name: test_expect_failure
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to fail with a description.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks the return code of a command within a test case.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the output of a command is empty.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs and checks for differences.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
